info: Edit this file to update clues, answers, and game checkpoints. Total questions can be expanded or adjusted.

questions.title: The Threshold
questions.question: I am not a classroom, yet all must pass. Morning rush and evening mass. Guarded strong where journeys start, Through me begins your campus part.
questions.hint: Where everyone enters and leaves the campus.

questions.title: The Pavilion
questions.question: I never bat, I never bowl, Yet I watch each wicket and every goal. Steps climb high in steady lines, Where cheers grow loud at thrilling times.
questions.hint: Look for the grassy field with spectator stairs.

questions.title: The Crimson Sign
questions.question: Find the place where business meets law. A tall red sign will guide what you saw. Not a classroom, yet it shows the way, To minds at work both night and day.
questions.hint: Near Learning Complex 1 entrance sign.

questions.title: The Paper Spitter
questions.question: When your wallet is empty and hopes are high, Follow the path of fancy stones. To the machine that eats cards and spits notes.
questions.hint: Dispenses physical cash.

questions.title: The Canopy
questions.question: Food and water in name I claim, Seek the tent that shares the same. Beneath the colors overhead, Your next direction waits to be read.
questions.hint: A food stall with overhead shade.

questions.title: Tricolor Arena
questions.question: Saffron, white, and green held high, Watching quietly as football players pass by. Not part of the game, yet central to all. Find the colors that never fall.
questions.hint: The ground where the national flag flies.

questions.title: The Fluffy Burrow
questions.question: Long ears, quick hops, and cotton tail white, I munch on greens from morning till night. I am not free to roam, I stay in a cage. Find me near food but off the stage.
questions.hint: Caged furry friends located close to eating areas.

questions.title: The Crimson Cube
questions.question: Heading for fun or heading to eat, You will pass a red cube on this street. Big, bold, and hard to ignore. Your next clue waits at its door.
questions.hint: Prominent red colored structure.

questions.title: The Dancing Waters
questions.question: I stand where many paths are curved, Between the halls where food is served. I throw up water, cool and bright, Shining gently in plain sight.
questions.hint: Water feature between the dining mess halls.

questions.title: The Dairy Treat
questions.question: When the sun is hot and games are tight, I bring cold smiles in every bite. Butter, milk and creamy delight, Standing close to the tennis sight.
questions.hint: The taste of India, right near the sports court.

questions.title: Southern Flavors
questions.question: Where dosas crisp and chutneys flow, Long red seats sit row by row. Hungry crowds gather day and night. Find the place of southern delight.
questions.hint: Popular canteen known for dosas with red benches.

questions.title: The Open Sea
questions.question: No single purpose, yet always full, No doors to close, no crowds to pull. Where sport meets snack and talks run free. Find the campus open sea.
questions.hint: Open-air gathering hub for snacks and banter.

questions.title: The Headquarters
questions.question: No exams are written here, Yet every student must appear. Fees, IDs, or documents in stock, Find the college control block.
questions.hint: Where student records and paperwork are handled.

questions.title: The Mentors' Haven
questions.question: After knowledge travels far and wide, Its keepers here choose to reside. No timetable rules this place. Find the homes of guiding grace.
questions.hint: Campus residential area for professors.

questions.title: The Silent Sanctuary
questions.question: Silence speaks louder than sound, Knowledge is waiting to be found. Before the books line every side, Find the door where minds open wide.
questions.hint: Where quiet study rules and shelves are endless.

questions.title: The Hive of Talents
questions.question: Where fun and fests come alive, And student talents always thrive. Near the office that guides your way, A locker quietly waits today.
questions.hint: Hub of student clubs, music, and council offices.

questions.title: The Forge
questions.question: Where tools speak louder than words, And practice matters more than awards. Not theory alone, but hands that work. Find the place where skills do not shirk.
questions.hint: Where machines, lathes, and welding sparks fly.

questions.title: The Summit (Final Destination)
questions.question: Where power is studied and justice is taught, Rise above both to the place they forgot. No deals are signed, no verdicts spoken. Just sky above and silence unbroken.
questions.hint: The highest accessible level of Learning Complex 1.

questions.title: The Hardcourt Hoop
questions.question: Dribble, pivot, shoot and score, Sneakers squeak on this level floor. Under the backboard net hangs low, Point your lens where the baskets glow.
questions.hint: Look for the backboards and hoops.

questions.title: The Grand Stage
questions.question: Echoes of applause and dramatic cries, Where spotlights shine before hundred eyes. Stepped rows rise up to the night sky view, Capture the stage where applause is due.
questions.hint: The grand venue for performances and college events.

questions.title: The Roasted Bean
questions.question: Steam rises high with a dark roasted brew, Where students gather when lectures are through. Pastries and cold drinks fill the display, Snap a photo where energy saves the day.
questions.hint: The favorite coffee and quick bite corner.

gameCheckpoints.title: Mini-Game 1: The Outpost
gameCheckpoints.question: Reach this location: Departmental Store and find the game coordinator.
gameCheckpoints.hint: Check with the coordinator stationed near the departmental store.

gameCheckpoints.title: Mini-Game 2: The Serene Shrine
gameCheckpoints.question: Reach this location: Campus Temple and complete the coordinator's challenge.
gameCheckpoints.hint: Find coordinator Nripendra stationed near the temple steps.

gameCheckpoints.title: Mini-Game 3: The Lecture Hall
gameCheckpoints.question: Reach this location: LT201 (Lecture Theatre 201) and solve the mystery task.
gameCheckpoints.hint: Look inside or near the entrance of LT201 for Akash.

gameCheckpoints.title: Mini-Game 4: The Flagpost Arena
gameCheckpoints.question: Reach this location: Football Ground Flag Hosting Area and pass the final physical challenge.
gameCheckpoints.hint: Coordinator Joy awaits you at the football flag post.
